text: Gavin Newsom had the biggest move in the nomination markets overnight, down 0.8 points to 10.6. Both books agreed on the direction, with Kalshi moving 1.0 point and Polymarket 0.6 points. Kalshi's market on whether Fain runs at all jumped 17 points, to 32 percent, even though Fain's nomination price barely moved. Our simulations disagreed with the traders: Newsom went from 21 to 22 percent of first-place finishes. Jon Ossoff leads the markets at 27, but the model likes AOC, who wins 29 percent of simulated primaries. About 11 in 100 simulated primaries end without a pledged majority, which sends the fight to the convention floor. Tonight's prices will show whether the Newsom move holds.
